what: Independent check of live-group removals on interchange/next-1117 (groups/_report/live_diff_2026-11-18.txt): was each removed claim really unsupported?

draw.method: Verifier's own draw: per-make quota (gm 11, subaru 5, mopar 4, ford 4, toyota 3), removed lines grouped by app list, families visited round-robin in seeded order; plus the one mopar CHANGED (narrowed) line. wiper-motor lines excluded (held). Every app family of every make is represented.

evidence_sources: oem-raw@dca9cd845f26 (the pin of the shipped groups) raw/<site>.jsonl and .lists*.jsonl read from git; live groups from groups/<ns>.json at the branch base main@2cb8191c; lot mix from inventory/decodes main@a85c654. No web search was needed for this part.

classes.a: unsupported or wrong by the evidence: the live claim showed at least one car that cannot carry the number (removal correct)
classes.b: supported for every car the live claim named (removal loses a true claim)
classes.c: cannot tell from the raw records

items.live_note: Ford catalog lists #F8XZ-19980-AA for both — trim-limited; verify the number on the part
items.evidence: Not a body issue: the 1998 Contour rows (fordpartsgiant.lists L456/L457) and the 1998 Mustang seed page (product L2286, 1998-ford-mustang--6_cyl_3_8l-4at_4r70w heater_controls) carry no body word. But the number is a 'Moisture Purge Module, use with harness kit F78Z-14K095-BA' listed for 11 Ford/Lincoln/Mercury lines 1994-2003 (FIT rows), a service add-on rather than either car's A/C control head. A donor is unlikely to carry it, and the claim implies the two control heads interchange. Removal correct, for a reason other than the body rule.

But the 2001 Outback H6 uses 72311AE11B ('FOR U.S.A.; W.EZ30D'), and FIT lists the Outback 2.5L H4 only, so L.L.Bean/VDC Outbacks (9+ on the lot) cannot carry it. The live note already said 'Turbo hood (scoop cutout): Legacy GT / Outback XT only'. Supported for every body named; removal loses a true claim. Apparent cause: curate._row_body_cover treats a Fitting Vehicle Options row as naming only body WORDS, and Subaru's S./W. codes are not words, so the row covers no body.
